rationale: Contract-stability lens. The wrapBDError %w-chain claim holds (BeadExists and IsUnsupportedFlagError reach *exec.ExitError via errors.As on the preserved chain; both operate on the ExitError's Stderr FIELD, not err.Error() text, so the folding cannot cause false positives there), no string-matching consumer breaks (isAlreadyClosedErr at internal/approve/impl.go:822 only ever sees RunBDCombined/tracedCombined errors, and tracedCombined is untouched — CombinedOutput never populates ExitError.Stderr anyway; codebase-wide there are only three err.Error() Contains matchers and none sits on a tracedOutput path), and the trace layer is unaffected (tracedOutput emits its trace event BEFORE wrapping and the event carries only op/args/ok — error text is never traced). However, the rendering-leg boundary claim is INCOMPLETE on next's own path: wrapBDError widens hostile bd stderr into EVERY tracedOutput error (RunBD/ListJSON/GetMetadata, all callers), while the termsafe escape was added at exactly one caller pair (QueryReady/QueryReadyForEpic). cmd/mindspec has no global escape — cobra prints RunE errors raw (cmd/mindspec/root.go:66 rootCmd sets no SilenceErrors/custom error renderer; cmd/mindspec/main.go:6 just Execute+exit), and escaping is strictly per-site (ADR-0042). At least two other bd shell-outs behind `mindspec next` now render raw hostile stderr, which AC-11's rendering leg ('no raw control byte reaches the rendered output' for 'a failing bd shell-out behind next') fails on: (a) `mindspec next <id> --emit-only` — cmd/mindspec/next.go:424 FetchBeadByID wraps with %w (internal/next/beads.go:222, same file the bead edited), so a fake bd failing `bd show` puts raw control bytes on the terminal; (b) the claim path's readiness gate — internal/next/ready_gate.go:70 wraps internal/validate/readiness/readiness.go:81's bead.RunBD("show") with %w and cmd/mindspec/next.go:265 returns gateErr straight to cobra. Both are reachable by a hostile bd that succeeds on `ready --json` and fails on `show` — the escape at the ready-query sites is bypassed entirely. These render sites are pre-existing, but they were UNREACHABLE by hostile stderr before this diff (error text was just 'exit status 1'); this bead's stderr folding is what arms them. Secondary: QueryReady/QueryReadyForEpic switched %w to %s (internal/next/beads.go:39,55), severing the error chain — no current consumer does errors.Is/As on that path (verified: cmd/mindspec/next.go is the only caller and only re-wraps; next.go:596's ErrPhaseLockTimeout check is on phase-sync errors), and the drop is forced by escape-at-wrap, but sibling FetchBeadAsOf explicitly documents the %w/IsUnsupportedFlagError fallback pattern for a version-sensitive flag and `bd ready --parent` is equally version-sensitive — the deliberate chain-drop needs pinning so a future fallback doesn't silently no-op.
concrete_changes_required: Close the two armed unescaped render legs on next's own path: apply the renderBDError treatment (or equivalent per-line termsafe escaping) to FetchBeadByID/FetchBeadAsOf's error wrapping in internal/next/beads.go:222/:244 (reachable via cmd/mindspec/next.go:424 `next <id> --emit-only`), and to the GateReadiness wrap at internal/next/ready_gate.go:70 (reachable via cmd/mindspec/next.go:263-265 on every claim). Add a hostile-shim regression test for at least one of these legs (fake bd succeeding on `ready --json`, failing on `show` with control-bearing stderr) asserting no raw control byte reaches the rendered output — today's tests cover only the QueryReady legs, so AC-11's rendering leg is unpinned exactly where it now fails. Note ready_gate.go/next.go overlap the bead-7 track — coordinate or scope the fix to internal/next/beads.go + a follow-up disposition for the ready_gate leg, but the gap must be dispositioned, not dropped.

Disposition (fix or explicit accepted-risk record) for the second-order metadata-write render legs the folding also arms on the claim path: cmd/mindspec/next.go:286 embeds a RecordReadinessOverride→MergeMetadata→GetMetadata error via %v into guard.NewFailure (internal/guard/recovery.go:71 does NOT escape), and describePhaseSyncFailure (cmd/mindspec/next.go:599, printed at :555/:579) embeds phase-sync errors via %v. Lower reach (error-path-of-error-path) but the same class.

Pin the deliberate %w→%s chain-drop at internal/next/beads.go:39/:55 in the QueryReady/QueryReadyForEpic (or renderBDError) doc comments: state that consumers must not type-inspect these errors (errors.As/Is will not reach the ExitError), contrasting FetchBeadAsOf's documented IsUnsupportedFlagError-via-%w contract, so a future bd-version fallback on `ready --parent` is not silently defeated.

findings.title: AC-11 rendering leg incomplete: wrapBDError arms pre-existing raw render sites on next's own path
findings.detail: wrapBDError (internal/bead/bdcli.go) folds hostile-adjacent bd stderr into every tracedOutput error codebase-wide, but the termsafe escape was added only at QueryReady/QueryReadyForEpic. cobra prints RunE errors raw (no global escape; per-site escaping is the house pattern). Unescaped legs behind `mindspec next`: (a) FetchBeadByID %w wrap at internal/next/beads.go:222 → cmd/mindspec/next.go:424 (`next <id> --emit-only`); (b) GateReadiness %w wrap at internal/next/ready_gate.go:70 over readiness.go:81's bead.RunBD("show") → returned raw at cmd/mindspec/next.go:265 on EVERY claim. A fake bd that succeeds on `ready --json` and fails on `show` bypasses the new escaping entirely and puts raw control bytes on the terminal — precisely the unsafe raw-passthrough AC-11's rendering leg says must fail. Before this diff these sites rendered only 'exit status 1'; the folding is what makes them hostile-reachable, so this is in-diff causality, not a pre-existing-condition dismissal.

findings.title: QueryReady/QueryReadyForEpic %w→%s severs the error chain (latent, undocumented)
findings.detail: internal/next/beads.go:39/:55 now format with %s(renderBDError(err)) — errors.As/Is can no longer reach the underlying *exec.ExitError. No current consumer type-inspects these errors (cmd/mindspec/next.go only re-wraps; the :596 ErrPhaseLockTimeout check is on a different error), and the drop is forced by the escape-at-construction design, but FetchBeadAsOf in the same file documents the %w chain as the IsUnsupportedFlagError fallback contract for a version-sensitive flag, and `bd ready --parent` is version-sensitive too. Needs a doc-comment pin at minimum.

findings.title: Verified stable: string-matchers, errors.As consumers, tracedCombined, trace layer
findings.detail: isAlreadyClosedErr (internal/approve/impl.go:822) matches err.Error() but only on RunBDCombined/tracedCombined errors — that path is untouched and CombinedOutput never populates ExitError.Stderr. IsUnsupportedFlagError and BeadExists (internal/bead/bdcli.go:97/:117) use errors.As and read the Stderr FIELD, so stderr folding neither breaks them nor creates false positives; wrapBDError's %w preservation is regression-tested. No 'exit status' string-matchers exist on bd paths (the gitutil/approve ones concern git). tracedOutput emits its trace event before wrapping with only op/args/ok — error text is never traced, so the now-larger error does not change trace shape or size. Cosmetic note: tracedOutput errors can now be multi-line; cobra's 'Error:' prefix renders them across lines, which no consumer asserts against.
